entries.key_id: integer for content keys; omitted for MSK
entries.purpose: master-signing | signing | encryption | key-agreement | kem | certificate
entries.private_material: portable encrypted or raw export used only before wrap

invariants: Exported representation MUST NOT contain plaintext private keys
Merge is a union by public fingerprint, not generation key_id
Same fingerprint with different secret material is vault_integrity
Same generation key_id with different fingerprints MUST be retained
Merge never discards a private historical key merely because it is not current
